selected_evidence.requirement: Node.js application is managed by infraset-nodejs.service and listens only on loopback port 3000
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, the service is active/enabled, Node.js listens on 127.0.0.1:3000, and its direct response is HTTP 200 with the exact required body.

selected_evidence.requirement: HAProxy serves port 80 and forwards `/` successfully
selected_evidence.summary: HAProxy listens on *:80; requests through node1's managed IP return HTTP 200 with body `infraset-nodejs`. Configuration validation also succeeds after reboot.

Healthy baseline used boot ID 3f72a8ce-4934-4c74-a2a9-e8144058b58d; the safe reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 2437f0e7-2d30-4e61-8da3-d1e457161b4f; both services, listeners, configuration, and HTTP responses recovered.

commands.command:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=InfraSet Node.js HTTP application
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=infraset-nodejs
Group=infraset-nodejs
WorkingDirectory=/opt/infraset-nodejs
ExecStart=/usr/bin/nodejs /opt/infraset-nodejs/server.js
Restart=always
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT_EOF
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service; sudo systemctl daemon-reload; sudo systemctl enable infraset-nodejs.service; systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/infraset-nodejs.service 2>&1 || true; systemctl is-enabled infraset-nodejs.service

sudo tee /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.infraset-new >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF'
global
    log /dev/log local0
    log /dev/log local1 notice
    chroot /var/lib/haproxy
    stats socket /run/haproxy/admin.sock mode 660 level admin
    stats timeout 30s
    user haproxy
    group haproxy
    daemon

defaults
    log global
    mode http
    option httplog
    option dontlognull
    timeout connect 5s
    timeout client 50s
    timeout server 50s

frontend infraset_http
    bind *:80
    default_backend infraset_nodejs

backend infraset_nodejs
    server nodejs 127.0.0.1:3000 check
ANTRIEB_HAPROXY_EOF
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.infraset-new; sudo chown root:root /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.infraset-new; sudo /usr/sbin/haproxy -c -V -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.infraset-new

if [ ! -e /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.pre-infraset ]; then sudo cp -p /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.pre-infraset; fi; sudo install -o root -g root -m 0644 /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg.infraset-new /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg; sudo /usr/sbin/haproxy -c -V -f /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg; sha256sum /etc/haproxy/haproxy.cfg
